_about: Which official feeds the election-night worker reads. A state is read only when its 'election' is filled in (the code the state uses for the Nov. 3, 2026 general election; it appears when the state publishes its results page). Sources for every state: docs/results-sources.md. Readers built so far: alaska (CSV by precinct), north_carolina (ZIP of precinct results), enhanced_voting (Georgia now; Utah, Washington and Idaho use the same platform).

AK.note: 2024 code was 24GENR; the 2026 general code is usually 26GENR
